name: toolsmith-file-lines
intent: Print numbered line ranges from several files in one call.
use_when: You need parts of one or more files in one call, with line numbers, to read or to edit by line.
You would otherwise chain `sed -n 'A,Bp'`, `grep -n` and `echo '==='` separators.
not_for: Searching many files for a pattern: use grep or the Grep tool.
Reading one whole file when the Read tool fits.
Regular expressions: /text/ matches literal text only.
input:
One or more arguments, each a file with an optional range after a colon:

- `path`: the whole file.
- `path:12`: line 12.
- `path:12-40`: lines 12 to 40 (a range past the end stops at the last line).
- `path:12-`: line 12 to the end.
- `path:12+20`: 20 lines from line 12.
- `path:/text/`: every line that contains the literal text, with --context lines around each (overlapping windows merge; separate ones are split by '--').

A colon followed by anything else is part of the file name. Quote an argument whose search text has spaces: 'app/models/user.rb:/def display_name/'.

options.text: Lines shown before and after each /text/ match (default 3).

output: For each argument, a header '==> path:range <==' (the whole file shows its line count, a search its match count), then each line as its number, two spaces and the text. A blank line separates the blocks. Problems (a missing file, a range that starts past the end, no match) go to stderr and the other arguments are still printed.

exit_codes.text: At least one argument could not be printed; the others were.
The arguments are wrong (no file given, a bad range, an unknown option).

examples.title: One range

files.app/models/user.rb:
class User < ApplicationRecord
  has_many :orders

  validates :email, presence: true
  validates :name, length: { maximum: 80 }

  def display_name
    name.presence || email
  end
end

examples.stdout:
==> app/models/user.rb:7-9 <==
7    def display_name
8      name.presence || email
9    end

examples.title: A text search and a whole file in one call

files.app/models/user.rb:
class User < ApplicationRecord
  has_many :orders

  validates :email, presence: true
  validates :name, length: { maximum: 80 }

  def display_name
    name.presence || email
  end
end

examples.stdout:
==> app/models/user.rb:/validates/ (2 matches) <==
4    validates :email, presence: true
5    validates :name, length: { maximum: 80 }

==> config/app.yml (2 lines) <==
1  name: shop
2  port: 3000

examples.title: A range past the end of the file
examples.stderr: toolsmith-file-lines: config/app.yml: starts at line 40, but the file has 2 lines

examples.title: Search text with a space, not quoted
examples.stderr:
toolsmith-file-lines: config/app.yml:/name:: a /text/ search needs text and a closing '/'; quote the whole argument when the text has spaces, e.g. 'app/x.rb:/def call/'
Run `toolsmith-file-lines --help` for usage, or `toolsmith-file-lines --llm` for the full guide.
